text:
support_john: Heads up: BrightShop reporting repeated 504s and very high tail latencies on hosted inference since 07:20 UTC. customer says spikes every ~5-10m. attaching their request ids.
alex_k: looking. any recent deploys or routing changes?
support_john: no deploys from customer side. they said it started after yesterday lunchtime. sent logs: request_id=rs_8a3f, rs_8a40, rs_8a7c.
sre-lina: I see gateway 504s and backend 5xx correlated with request queue depth hitting limit on a few hosts. probable continuous-batcher backlog.
maria_g: getting traces now. suspecting KV cache warmup + longseq traffic causing batch assembly slowdowns.
devon: can you paste the quick query for queue depths?
alex_k: run on prod-metrics: `sum(rate(queue_depth_count[1m])) by (host)`
maria_g: traces: 
```
# snippet from trace rs_8a3f
gateway -> ingress: 200ms
ingress queue wait: 1.2s
continuous-batcher wait: 3.8s
model-invoke: 420ms
result send: 50ms
```
sre-lina: continuous-batcher waiting 3.8s is the problem: batching window accumulating due to slow dequeue.
support_john: customer is pushing p95 ~3.5s now, says UX is unusable. CS escalated.
devon: what caused dequeue slowdown? slow GPU invocation? starved batchers?
maria_g: GPU latencies for those hosts are normal (~400ms). I see sudden spikes in `processing_queue_len` and `eviction_count` on the KV cache. Suggests KV thrash + increased prefix misses that slow down batch formation.
alex_k: also seeing auth token rotation errors for a small fraction of tenant requests around 07:18 — some requests bounced and retried, increasing queue pressure.
support_john: customer noted ~20% failed requests initially then latency spike. they retried client-side.
sre-lina: retries amplify queue backlog — classic retry storm. we need mitigation: reduce client retry window? but we can also enable temporary route limit for tenant.
maria_g: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase queue depth max on affected hosts, 2) enable aggressive prefix caching, 3) apply tenant-level rate limit to shed excess.
devon: are we comfortable bumping queue depth in prod? risk of memory pressure.
alex_k: if we only bump on the affected pool (hosted-gw-pool-7) for few minutes and monitor, should be OK.
sre-lina: alternative is to redirect BrightShop traffic to warm spare region to avoid per-host backlog. but cross-region latency may increase.
support_john: customer preference: keep in-region if possible. they asked for root cause and ETA.
maria_g: I'll try prefix cache tweak first (drop TTL to force fewer MV cache misses) and enable per-tenant shed for BrightShop ID.
ingress-bot: deploy started for runtime-config/prefix-cache-ttl change by maria_g at 07:48 UTC.
maria_g: deployed config 07:48: `prefix_cache: ttl: 10s -> 60s` (increased to reduce misses). also toggled `tenant_shed: brightshop=true` at 07:49 (soft shed at 70% queue).
devon: monitoring dashboards now — queue depth falling on pool-7 from ~420 -> ~120 in 3 minutes.
alex_k: gateway 504s dropped dramatically after 07:52. p95 improved from 3.5s -> 520ms.
support_john: passing update to BrightShop: they report UX recovered. will they accept temporary configuration changes? they asked for longer-term fix.
sre-lina: root cause summary so far: combination of small auth token rotation failures causing client retries + sudden longseq workload with low prefix reuse -> KV cache misses -> batcher assembly starvation -> queue depth hit -> tail timeouts. retries amplified pressure.
maria_g: action items: 1) fix token rotation edge-case in auth-service (maria_g), 2) increase default prefix cache TTL across pool (maria_g + runtime), 3) add tenant-aware early-shed policy to avoid retry amplification (alex_k + sre), 4) run load test simulating longseq + retry pattern (devon).
alex_k: creating follow-up ticket and setting SLA to contact BrightShop with RCA by EOD.
support_john: Customer success note: BrightShop asks for more visibility into their per-route latencies and token failure logs. we'll grant access to sanitized traces.
devon: repro steps for infra team to run: 
```
# repro scenario (scale locally)
1. spawn continuous-batcher with N=50 concurrent producers
2. push 10k requests with 10% auth-fail then retry after 200-500ms jitter
3. include 30% longseq requests (seq_len > 1024) with low prefix reuse
4. observe queue_depth, kvcache_miss_rate, batch_wait_time
```
maria_g: I've opened GH issue infra/kv-cache#712 with traces and proposed config.
sre-lina: tagging runtime oncall to review tenant_shed thresholds before making them permanent.
alex_k: thanks everyone. keeping thread open. if anything regresses we escalate to page.
support_john: BrightShop happy with interim fix. they requested postmortem and timeline. I'll coordinate. :thumbsup:
